idea.title: Slice Serve
idea.hook: Draw one cut line through a pizza or cake to serve a customer's exact portion — miss the target percentage by more than the tolerance and they complain; three complaints and you're fired.
idea.prototype: Canvas shows a circular or irregular food polygon. A customer bubble shows a target portion percent (e.g. 25%). The player drags ONE straight cut line (mousedown->mouseup / touch); the engine splits the food polygon by the infinite line, computes each piece's area via the shoelace formula, and serves the piece closest to the order. Within tolerance = tip earned (streak grows a tip multiplier; a tight inner band = PERFECT bonus); outside tolerance = complaint +1. Shapes escalate: circle -> wedge/semicircle -> irregular blob -> slowly rotating food -> drifting food. Orders escalate: exact% -> bigger/smaller half -> leave-X%-on-plate -> two-cut multi orders. Tolerance tightens each customer. Win: reach the $100 tip target for the shift. Lose: 3rd complaint.
idea.mutation_of: Slice Master (Poki popular — slicing/drag input trending) + Harvest Simulator (Poki) + the satisfying-clearing signal in the 2026-06-06 Telegram digest (Clean Sweep Donut / satisfying cleaning direction)
idea.why_novel: geometric ESTIMATION under irreversibility — judging visual area percentage by eye with ONE non-undoable cut, scored against a precise portion target. No portal game combines the slice/drag input with a portion-accuracy scoring mechanic; existing slicing games (Slice Master) score on obstacle-dodging, not area precision.
idea.non_timer_pressure: complaint lives (3 complaints = fired) + a cash/earnings target ($100 tips) as the win threshold + cut irreversibility. NO countdown timer drives the core cut — aiming is untimed.
idea.lose_condition: gs='GAMEOVER' when complaints >= 3 (COMPLAINT_LIMIT). A complaint is added when a served cut misses the order percentage by more than the current tolerance. Reachable from random play in <60s (random cuts miss an ~8-10% band most of the time).

synthesizer_brief: satisfying / precision-cutting family (satisfying_cleanup-adjacent skill game), a clean mechanical gap (no slicing game in the portfolio). CTR archetype best fits: cozy_cute (glossy appetising food close-up) and puzzle_objects (large tactile object in a near-solved state). Cover steers toward an appetising, high-contrast food-being-sliced moment: a glossy pizza + cake mid-slice with a clean steel knife lifting an exact wedge, saturated foreground, quieter warm-wood background, NO text, NO fake UI. Icon: single readable silhouette (sliced pie/cake wedge + knife), ~70% of frame, two-color contrast, one action cue. Core mechanic = polygon-line area split with a single irreversible drag; pressure via 3 complaint lives + a $100 tip target; in-session arc escalates shape (circle->wedge->blob->rotating->drifting), order type (exact->bigger/smaller->leave-on-plate->multi-cut) and tightening tolerance, with a consecutive-cut tip multiplier + perfect-band bonus for the don't-break-the-streak pull. Mobile-portrait first.
